hotels.title: Northeast Tasmania Eco-Luxury: Coastal Villas & Residence with Sauna Session & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Escape to the beautiful Tasmanian seaside at this sustainable luxury retreat, where design-led villas offer the ultimate wilderness experience. Set among the rugged Tasmanian coastline between the iconic Wineglass Bay and Bay of Fires, this eco-powered haven features everything you need to soak up the region’s spectacular natural majesty. Unwind in a thoughtfully designed villa - equipped with private hot tubs and expansive windows showcasing sweeping ocean views - or take your escape to the next level at the sprawling Rockpool Residence, featuring ultra-modern interiors, an infinity pool, spa and space for up to six guests.
